title: Bitcoin's worst month since 2022

lines: Bitcoin's drop in November — its worst month since the 2022 crypto crash.

Investors pulled a record $3.79 billion out of U.S. Bitcoin ETFs this month.

Hold crypto in an app, an ETF or your brokerage?
Then this is your money, not just a headline.

source_line: Sources: Seeking Alpha, Moneycontrol, Bloomberg, Nov 2026
caption:
Bitcoin just posted its worst month since the 2022 crypto crash. It's down about 21% in November, its steepest monthly drop since June 2022 (Moneycontrol; Bloomberg).

It slipped below $60,000 for the first time since July before clawing back above $61,000. And investors pulled a record $3.79 billion out of U.S. Bitcoin ETFs this month, with BlackRock's fund alone shedding about $2.47 billion (Seeking Alpha; Cointelegraph).

If you hold crypto in an app, an ETF or your brokerage, this is your money — one analyst says the average ETF buyer is now underwater.

My take: a 21% month is brutal, but the biggest losses come from buying the top on hype and selling the bottom in fear.
